tasks.title: Carry full transcript across provider switch
tasks.description: Replace the current lossy provider-switch handoff with a full visible-transcript handoff so the target provider can see the prior chat history when Relay creates the replacement managed session.

tasks.title: Add Gemini CLI provider
tasks.description: Implement Gemini CLI as a first-class Relay provider using Gemini ACP, matching Claude and Codex managed-session support while preserving Relay’s provider-driven architecture.

tasks.title: Generalize provider runtime modes
tasks.description: Collapsed Relay's `skipPermissions`/`planMode` booleans into a single `ProviderRuntimeMode` enum (`approval-required` | `full-access` | `plan`) across server, UI, DB, and tests. Provider drivers translate the canonical mode to their native semantics (Claude SDK `permissionMode`, Codex `approvalPolicy`+`sandbox`+`collaborationMode.mode`). UI renders a single runtime-mode picker driven by `capabilities.runtimeModes`. SQLite migration v24 backfills `runtime_mode` and drops `skip_permissions` on both `sessions` and `managed_sessions`. Richer Codex options and richer interactive request payloads were deferred — left for a follow-up.

tasks.title: Add Gemini ACP transport and managed session adapter
tasks.description: Build a thin in-repo ACP client over NDJSON and a Gemini provider session that spawns gemini --acp, manages lifecycle, streams output and activity, and bridges Gemini interactive requests into Relay.

tasks.title: Implement Gemini transcript replay and managed-session restore
tasks.description: Parse Gemini session JSON into Relay history and resolve Gemini session ids back to storage paths so managed Gemini chats can hydrate, revive, and rebuild state from canonical transcript files.

tasks.title: Add Gemini model discovery and per-session sandbox switching
tasks.description: Expose Gemini models through Relay provider metadata with dynamic discovery plus fallback catalog, and let Relay change Gemini sandbox settings per session even if the Gemini process must restart and reload the same chat.

tasks.title: Add external Gemini session discovery and exact process mapping
tasks.description: Discover Gemini sessions started outside Relay from Gemini storage and running processes, with reliable mapping between live Gemini processes and session files when multiple external sessions exist in the same repo.

tasks.title: Cover Gemini provider rollout with tests and docs
tasks.description: Add regression coverage and documentation for Gemini provider support, including ACP transport, transcript replay, runtime switching, sandbox behavior, shared UI changes, and rollout caveats.
